node.title: Primitive exact-list star coverage by the u1 record ledger
node.statement: At every x4 official row and every transported quotient row, fix the declared support-wise priority map and a primitive residual locator-prefix fiber. For each base support S0, inject every other residual support S, through its canonical order-t star-PTE record (S\S0,S0\S), into exactly one F-4 minimal record counted by the re-posed u1_x4_direct_column_budget ledger, with multiplicity at most one and with the same quotient/dihedral/moment/U2/DLI strips. Equivalently, prove that the post-strip official-row residue admits the required minimal first owner; otherwise broaden u1 to count all required general records and re-prove its budget. This coverage gives |F_z^prim|-1<=R_min and is required uniformly before the u1 bound can be consumed as a worst-word list bound.
node.falsifier: A correctly stripped primitive same-prefix pair whose canonical star-PTE record is not assigned to any u1 record, is assigned only after changing strip ownership, or incurs unbounded multiplicity under the proposed coverage map.
